items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The band got along with these female impersonaters very well and none of them ever tried to have an affair with any of us, that I know about.

ctx.x: The six female impersonators were not bad as chorus girls and some looked almost like girls. But later the manager added six more sissies and some of them had muscles like a prizefighter and they really looked funny in those chorus girls costumes and the big muscles showing in their arms and legs.
They all XXXXXX had chosen female names and one called itself

Clara Bow, another was Theda Barra and one quite famous was known as Mother Smothers. One night a few of us were talking very seriously with Clara Bow and we asked him or her! if he had ever had any sexual relations with a female, and he said, never. He had always felt that he was a female. The band got along with these female impersonaters very well and none of them ever tried to have an affair with any of us, that I know about.
